title: Wayne's World
about: Two metalhead friends get their public access cable show picked up by a slick producer.
cue: Serve the snacks when Bohemian Rhapsody comes on in the Mirthmobile.
faces: Aurora, Illinois. Crullers, cops and Cassandra.
"Garth brought the snacks and I brought the dip. Grab a seat in the basement, the show starts after dinner."

    StartersStan Mikita's mini jam doughnutsYeast doughnuts rolled in sugar and piped with raspberry jamHow to make it350g plain flour7g dried yeast180ml milk30g butter120g caster sugar1 egg1 pinch salt150g raspberry jam2 L vegetable oilWarm the milk with the butter and a little of the sugar, then mix with the yeast, egg, flour and salt.Knead until smooth and elastic.Prove until doubled.Roll into 20 balls and prove again.Fry in the oil at 175°C for a couple of minutes, turning, until golden.Roll in the remaining sugar while warm, then poke a hole in each and pipe in raspberry jam.Product placement pizza bitesSmall pizza rounds with sauce, mozzarella and a slice of pepperoniHow to make it500g pizza dough1 jar pizza sauce150g mozzarella, grated16 slices of pepperoni (100g)Heat the oven to 230°C. Roll out the dough and cut into 16 rounds.Spread each with pizza sauce, add mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni.Bake until bubbling.Present one to the camera with a cheesy grin before eating.Mirthmobile cheesy chilli popcornHeadbanging in the back seat of the MirthmobileHow to make itAs written, serves 4Big batch of popcorn tossed in butter, cheddar powder, chilli and smoked paprika, mixed with salty pretzels and passed round the back seat.Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large pot, add 120g popcorn kernels, cover and shake over medium heat until the popping slows.Melt 60g butter and pour over the popcorn.Mix 4 tbsp cheddar cheese powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika and half a tsp chilli powder and toss through until coated.Mix in 100g small pretzels and serve in a big bowl.Jalapeño cheddar poppersPassed round the Mirthmobile during Bohemian Rhapsody.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsMirthmobile pepperoni pizza squaresThin crust pizza with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, cut into squaresHow to make it500g pizza dough1 jar pizza sauce250g mozzarella100g pepperoni150g mushrooms, slicedHeat the oven to its highest setting with a steel or tray inside.Stretch the dough into two thin bases.Top with sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and mushrooms.Bake until the crust blisters. Cut into squares.Noah's Arcade loaded chilli dogsBenjamin's arcade sponsorHow to make itAs written, serves 4Franks griddled until blistered in steamed buns, loaded with beef chilli, melted cheddar, pickled jalapeños, diced onion and a stripe of mustard.Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water and simmer 25 minutes.Griddle 8 franks for 6 minutes until blistered.Steam 8 hot dog buns.Fill each with a frank, a spoon of chilli and grated cheddar and grill 1 minute to melt.Top with jalapeños, diced onion and mustard.SweetsStan Mikita's crullersFried choux pastry crullers dipped in honey icingHow to make it250ml water, for the dough100g butter150g plain flour4 eggs1 L vegetable oil200g icing sugar2 tbsp honey2 tbsp water, for the glazeBoil the water and butter, beat in the flour and cook a minute. Cool.Beat in the eggs one at a time.Pipe rings onto squares of baking paper.Fry in the oil at 180°C, paper and all, until puffed, then lift the paper out.Whisk the icing sugar with the honey and water and dip the crullers.DrinksAurora cherry cola floatCherry syrup, vanilla ice cream and cold cola, topped with a cocktail cherryHow to make it60ml cherry syrup8 scoops of vanilla ice cream1 L cold cola4 cocktail cherriesChill four big glasses in the freezer.Add cherry syrup and two scoops of ice cream to each.Pour the cola slowly down the side so the foam rises without spilling.Top with a cherry and serve with straws.Cherry limeadeParty on, Wayne.
